metadata.value: This project contains the code to reproduce the experiments in the paper [Neural Code Search Revisited: Enhancing Code Snippet Retrieval through Natural Language Intent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.12193). It implements retrieval systems for annotated code snippets: pairs of a code snippet and a short natural language description.
